package.description: Organize and de-duplicate every photo and video you own, on your own computer.

en-US.description: Organize and de-duplicate every photo and video you own, on your own computer.
en-US.longDescription: PictureAttic is a local-only desktop app that gathers photos and videos scattered across phone dumps, camera cards, old drives and cloud exports into one organized archive, filed by year and the camera that took them, with duplicates removed. Nothing is ever uploaded.
en-US.name: PictureAttic
